classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that increasing the number of workers decreases completion time, then calculate through one worker.

content.prompt: If 9 men can build a wall in 63 days, how long would it take 40 men to build the same wall if they worked at the same pace?

answer.short:
$14.175$ days.

Find the time for one man, then divide by 40.
answer.worked:
One man would take 9 times as long as 9 men. Forty men would take one-fortieth of the time for one man.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Time for one man}&=63\times9\text{ days}\\\text{Time for one man}&=567\text{ days}\\\text{Time for 40 men}&=567\div40\text{ days}\\\text{Time for 40 men}&=14.175\text{ days}\end{align*}$$
